objective: sum over periods of hours * (sum over thermal types of cost_per_hour * ngen + cost_per_mwh_above_min * (output - min_output_mw * ngen) + sum over hydro units of cost_per_hour * hydro_on) + sum of startup_cost * nstart + sum of hydro startup_cost * hydro_start

period.description: Time window of the day, as start-end hour (00-06 = midnight to 6 am)
period.label: period

order.description: Position in the day (1 = first period). Consecutive periods are linked by start-ups and the reservoir level; the period before the first is the last (the day is a cycle)
order.label: period order

hours.description: Length of the period; hourly costs, reservoir drawdown and pumping are multiplied by it Structural: the periods partition the 24-hour day.
hours.label: period length

demand_mw.description: Predicted power demand during the period
demand_mw.label: predicted demand

type.description: Thermal generator type (the notebook's types 0, 1 and 2)
type.label: generator type

units_available.description: Number of generators of this type that can run
units_available.label: units available

min_output_mw.description: Least output of each running unit
min_output_mw.label: minimum output per unit

max_output_mw.description: Most output of each running unit; also what a running unit counts towards the reserve
max_output_mw.label: maximum output per unit

cost_per_hour.description: Cost of each running unit per hour, covering its output up to the minimum
cost_per_hour.label: hourly running cost per unit

cost_per_mwh_above_min.description: Cost of each MWh produced above the running units' minimum output
cost_per_mwh_above_min.label: cost per MWh above minimum

startup_cost.description: Cost of starting one unit of this type
startup_cost.label: start-up cost per unit

units_on_at_start.description: Units of this type already running before the first period; they need no start-up Initial state carried over from the previous day; not a what-if input.
units_on_at_start.label: units running at the start of the day

hydro.description: Hydroelectric unit (the notebook's plants A and B)
hydro.label: hydro unit

output_mw.description: Fixed output while the unit runs; the full amount always counts towards the reserve
output_mw.label: hydro output

cost_per_hour.description: Cost per hour while the unit runs
cost_per_hour.label: hourly running cost

depletion_m_per_hour.description: Reservoir level lost per hour while the unit runs
depletion_m_per_hour.label: reservoir drawdown per hour

on_at_start.description: 1 if the unit is already running before the first period (no start-up needed), else 0 Initial state carried over from the previous day; not a what-if input.
on_at_start.label: running at the start of the day

reserve_margin.description: Running thermal units at maximum output plus the full output of every hydro unit must cover predicted demand times (1 + reserve_margin); 0.15 = 115% of demand
reserve_margin.label: reserve margin

pump_mwh_per_m.description: Electricity consumed by pumping to raise the reservoir level by one metre
pump_mwh_per_m.label: pumping energy per metre of reservoir

decision_variables.ngen[period, type]: integer number of thermal units of the type running (>= 0)
decision_variables.output[period, type]: total output of the type's running units, MW (>= 0)
decision_variables.nstart[period, type]: integer number of thermal units of the type started at the beginning of the period (>= 0)
decision_variables.hydro_on[period, hydro]: binary, 1 if the hydro unit runs
decision_variables.hydro_start[period, hydro]: binary, 1 if the hydro unit is started at the beginning of the period
decision_variables.pump[period]: power used to pump water back into the reservoir, MW (>= 0)
decision_variables.reservoir_level[period]: reservoir level at the end of the period, metres above its lowest point in the day (>= 0)

constraints.demand[period]: sum_t output + sum_h output_mw * hydro_on >= demand_mw + pump
constraints.reservoir[period]: reservoir_level = reservoir_level[previous period] + hours * pump / pump_mwh_per_m - sum_h depletion_m_per_hour * hours * hydro_on (the previous period of the first is the last: the level ends the day where it started)
constraints.reserve[period]: sum_t max_output_mw * ngen >= (1 + reserve_margin) * demand_mw - sum_h output_mw
constraints.thermal_startup[period, type]: ngen <= ngen[previous period] + nstart (units_on_at_start before the first period)
constraints.hydro_startup[period, hydro]: hydro_on <= hydro_on[previous period] + hydro_start (on_at_start before the first period)

hydro_on.label: hydro unit-periods running (0/1 per unit and period)

hydro_start.label: hydro unit start-ups (0/1 per unit and period)
